Maria — thanks for the context, and congrats on getting to procurement. I put together a short summary below and attached the latest enterprise rate card. Quick answers up front: Redwood bills generation tokens and embedding units separately (embeddings billed per vector request, generation billed per output token). We support automatic model fallbacks by policy; dedicated capacity / committed tiers get priority routing and slower fallback windows.

Baseline hosted API (public list, USD) — generation:
- 0–100M tokens/month: $0.0030 / token
- 100M–500M tokens/month: $0.0022 / token
- 500M–2B tokens/month: $0.0016 / token

Embeddings: $0.0005 per embedding request (small vector sizes typical)

Suggested terms for a 12-month committed plan (example PO):
- Committed volume: 1,000,000,000 generation tokens / month (12-month term)
- Base blended price: we can offer a custom slab that targets $0.00145 / generation token for committed volume (roughly ~9–12% below the 500M–2B public slab, delivered as monthly billing credit)
- Additional benefits: 99.9% routing SLA, quarterly performance review, dedicated onboarding credits
- Minimum annual spend floor applies (we can model this into the PO)

Notes/assumptions:
- Blended price above assumes most tokens are generation; embeddings charged on top at list or negotiable if large embed volume
- We can also structure a multi-slab pricing that kicks in monthly (e.g., first 200M @ $0.0018, next 300M @ $0.0015, balance @ $0.0013) if you prefer tiered invoices rather than a blended credit.

I'll loop in Laura for commercial terms and Vivek for finance to scope approval for credits. Attached: Redwood_Enterprise_RateCard_v2.pdf and a quick modeling sheet.

Best,
Nikhil
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Looping in a quick commercial take. For a 1B committed monthly volume we typically recommend one of two structures depending on legal preference:

Option A — Blended committed rate (simpler PO):
- 12-month commitment at $0.00145 / generation token (embeddings at $0.00045 after 10M embed requests/mo)
- 60-day termination with milestone payments (standard SOW)
- 3% annual volume growth credit if you auto-renew for year two

Option B — Slabed monthly invoice (preferred for variable consumption):
- Monthly invoice with slabs: 0–200M @ $0.0018; 200M–600M @ $0.0015; 600M+ @ $0.00125
- Billing is monthly but discounts are guaranteed for committed year
- Overage handling: bursts above committed monthly cap are billed at list but can be grandfathered into the next month's slabs if you give 72h notice

Commercial asks for the PO: billing entity name, purchase order cadence, and whether you need gross-to-net mapping for internal chargebacks. Happy to bake in a one-time onboarding credit.

-Laura (Commercial Lead)
